snippet.title: How does RAT IRL win lane in grandmaster 600 lp on EUW? - [Twitch adc VOD review]
snippet.description:
Hi guys, 
in this video I'm going trough a game of RAT IRL playing twitch adc on a 600 lp account. It's interesting to see how he survives laning phase when playing against high elo opponents since twitch is a champion who is really weak early game. Hope you guys enjoyed the video and also please follow me on twitter : https://twitter.com/eyez1l

snippet.title: Learn how to win lane in high Diamond - [Twitch ADC VOD review]
snippet.description: Hi guys, and sorry for the long hiatus. Good news, I am back and I will be posting a video every 3 days starting from today, so new video this Sunday. Enjoy today's video where i show you guys how to win lane with twitch in high diamond. We learn how to manipulate minion waves to our advantage, how to set up ganks for your team, when to reset, when to freeze, when to push any many other interesting and really important concepts.

snippet.title: How to lane when your support is always roaming - ADC Vod review
snippet.description:
Hi guys,
welcome to my latest video, in this one I will be showing you guys how we get fed with twitch while being forced to play the laning phase 2v1 while our support roams to go help other lanes.

snippet.title: What videos do you guys wanna see on this channel?
snippet.description:
Hi guys,
this is just a small video asking what type of videos you wanna see me upload. Do you guys rather see VOD reviews or live game commentaries? The VOD reviews would mostly be like the videos I've been uploading whilst for the live game commentaries there would a lot of options  like and unranked to diamond, Smurf games on my gold/plat accounts or high elo games on my main account (D1-D2 elo). Also please tell me how long do you guys want my videos to be and how often should i upload per week. Thank you very much for everything take care guys!

snippet.title: How to win lane with Twitch/Lulu - Laning phase review
snippet.description:
Hi guys,
welcome back to a new video where I'm showing you a new build I like to go on Twitch. You go Manamune, into IE, into Runaans, into situational items. Hopefully you guys learned a lot about wave management and if you have any questions I will happily answer them.

snippet.title: Thought process behind high diamond ADC mid game Macro
snippet.description:
Hi guys, welcome back to another video, in this one we are picking off where we left off the last video at, if you wanna check it out here is the link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uFtYJSQAzqQ&t=2s
As for today's video, we're gonna be focusing on mid game macro decisions like how to 1-3-1, what to do when you won lane hard and already took the tier 1 tower, how to use fog of war to your advantage, how to trade objectives and many other concepts. Hope you enjoy the video take care guys.

snippet.title: Everything you need to know about destroying a high diamond bot lane as adc
snippet.description: Hi guys, in this video I show you everything that needs to be known to smash a high diamond level bot lane. From when to freeze, to when to fast push, to when to slow push, to how to set up dives, to when to trade, all those concepts are shown and explained in this video. Hope you guys enjoy, leave a  like and subscribe if you do and I hope you guys have a great day.

snippet.description: Hi guys, here is a vod review of a laning phase i had in high diamond. Alot of fundamentals of laning as an adc are showed in here, so i really recommend to watch this if you want to improve as an adc player.
